title: Crowds in front of bottlenecks from the perspective of physics and social psychology
citation: Adrian, J., Boltes, M., Holl, S., Sieben, A., & Seyfried, A. (2018). Crowds in front of bottlenecks from the perspective of physics and social psychology [data set]. Pedestrian Dynamics Data Archive. https://doi.org/10.34735/ped.2018.1

files.transformation: Preserve the publisher ZIP archive unchanged. The source-specific adapter reads only root text files matching RUN_PRIMING_WIDTH_MOTIVATION.txt, requires the publisher id/frame/x/m/y/m/z/m header, treats frames as 25 Hz, and reports first positive-to-nonpositive y crossings at the publisher-described entry-gate line y = 0 m.

supported_primitives: Source-locked descriptive 2D trajectories and observed passage through one fixed 0.5 m controlled entry gate; useful only for disclosed, out-of-domain structural exit-capacity exploration.
exclusions: Not an empirical benchmark source, calibration source, station or interchange proxy, general exit-capacity law, queueing model validation, body-dimension source, route-choice source, information-behavior source, evacuation source, population profile, accessibility evidence, or safety evidence.
